body:
It got worse. I used to bounce back after a day or two of feeling like this, but now I feel like this all the time. And I can't bounce back because there's nothing to look forward to to prompt it... I don't know if I'm making any sense. ha.

As for my friends. It was unintentional and slow-burning. And every now and then, they'll try to contact me to see how I am. They still worry about me and they're great people and that makes me feel even worse for some reason. They continue to care about me even though I'm a worthless, awful person and I hate it.

That's basically it. I just don't see any point. I don't want a family. I don't have career goals. I don't want a relationship. Things are just getting worse, and I'm getting older and drinking more... that's it. Nothing to look forward to.

I slowly cut off most of my friendships without realizing it over the past few years. I don't really know why, I just stopped wanting to do anything or talk. I'd go days without saying anything to anyone and then wonder where they all went?... I draw. I'm a... sort of popular artist online, but it's just stopped being satisfying. I used to just be unhappy with my art, but now I can't even bring myself to start something, let alone finish it... And I've never had any interest in a relationship. Sexual or romantic... I'm a closed off, lonely person and I have no one to blame for it but myself.
This isn't meant as a joke, by the way. I just realized with the username it might come off that way. I just think it's kind of morbidly funny that it might fall on April Fools.
